name: Former Maribor Prison
zag_role: Partner in the project CABE, Circular Approaches in the Built Environment (Driving Urban Transitions, January 2025 to December 2027), with a demonstration case in Slovenia
description: CABE develops and pilots urban resource-sharing infrastructures and circular solutions that reuse construction and demolition waste, with demonstration cases planned in Switzerland, Slovenia and Turkey. The former prison (KPD) on Pobreška cesta is the Maribor site presented at the ZAG Open Day.

source_differences: size: almost 16,000 m2 (press.um.si) against Project/building proportions: Over 1000 sqm (remakingthecity.urbact.eu)
Year built: 1884 to 1889 in the university press source against 1885 in the cadastre for building 416.

Link to ZAG: the Driving Urban Transitions page lists Zavod za gradbeništvo Slovenije as a CABE partner and gives Slovenia as one of three living lab countries. None of the listed sources names the former prison as the CABE case. The record states that the site was presented at the ZAG Open Day, and no public source for that is stored.
